messages.content: I’ll submit the first day’s energy and reserve positions, then update dispatch at every watch as forecasts, prices, and notices arrive.

The first two days have settled at $64,002 net profit, with no failure-to-provide charges. All three DAM gates were submitted. I’m now managing the final day’s dispatch, reserve backing, and 100 MWh ending-SoC requirement.
